name: Bag
description: Effects that occur when the item is used directly from the player's bag.

name: Battle
description: Effects that activate during battle when specific conditions are met.

name: Field
description: Effects that occur when the item is used outside of battle in the overworld.

name: Held
description: Effects that apply while the item is held by a Pokémon.

name: Passive
description: Items without an active use mechanic; includes decorations, crafting materials, currency, sell-only items, and passive boosts from ownership.

name: Story
description: Items that advance story progression or complete quests when delivered or used.
